text:
sarah (CEO): quick follow-up to today's all-hands about the reorg + headcount allocation. i'll post the short plan here and take questions.
jen (Recruiting): is this a freeze or reprioritization?
dave (CTO): reprioritization for next two quarters. infra/runtime, Dedicated, and customer-facing product teams get approvals first.
lisa (Dir Eng): concretely: latency, autoscaling, KV/prefix caching, and serving reliability teams prioritized.
mike (Product): how do PMs request priority?
maria (People Ops): open a prioritization ticket in internal/hires and @mention @jen + @lisa. weekly triage.
raj (Eng): are we favoring senior hires?
dave (CTO): target ~60% senior+, ~40% mid-level; juniors only where mentorship lanes exist.
sarah (CEO): timeline: org charts by end of week; role mapping and backfills over 3 weeks; prioritized reqs start immediately; hiring ramps in Q2.
jen (Recruiting): pipelines continue. deprioritized roles paused with candidate notice.
maria (People Ops): internal moves encouraged 97 post in #internal-moves and discuss with manager; we'll expedite transfers.
mike (Product): impact on growth/PLG hiring?
sarah (CEO): still funded but fewer slots; tie hires to clear customer outcomes for priority.
lisa (Dir Eng): operational merge: two infra pods -> "Serving" and "Platform"; visual org map by Friday.
jen (Recruiting): hiring managers: update JDs and leveling rubrics before posting.
maria (People Ops): comp bands unchanged today; exceptions case-by-case. relocation/visa handled per region.
raj (Eng): research/ML hiring?
dave (CTO): limited quota; priority for roles improving inference or serving stack.
mike (Product): can we see headcount numbers?
maria (People Ops): publishing read-only headcount sheet (Serving/Runtime, Dedicated/Infra, Product/Growth, Research/ML, CS) by EOD Wed.
jen (Recruiting): SLA-critical hires: mark ticket "urgent-sla" with customer name to jump triage.
lisa (Dir Eng): managers with complex mapping questions DM me for a 1:1.
sarah (CEO): we'll update this thread with org map + headcount doc. if folks want an AMA follow-up, we'll schedule one. :thumbsup: 
raj (Eng): thanks 97 helps a lot.
oncall-bot: uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-03-19-notes.md
